modules.question: Q1
modules.module: combine complementary ridge/edge/texture detectors for high-recall candidate generation, then classify connected components using compact morphology/texture features
modules.compatibility: prefer learned interpretable weights when labels exist; split by original image before tuning

modules.question: Q2
modules.module: separate fracture-instance grouping from robust periodic fit; use RANSAC/refit and residual rejection
modules.compatibility: fix period to physical circumference when calibrated; axis semantics for cluster merge must be explicit

modules.question: Q3
modules.module: decompose ordered fracture centerline into low-frequency/main shape and multiscale residuals (Fourier/spline + wavelet) to diagnose where roughness originates
modules.compatibility: do not treat decomposition itself as a validated improved JRC estimator

modules.question: Q3
modules.module: compare roughness estimates over increasing sampling budgets and adaptive/equal schemes; record convergence and computational budget
modules.compatibility: dense sampling is a numerical reference unless independent ground truth exists

modules.question: Q4
modules.module: use a transparent spatial coverage score to generate feasible candidate measurement locations and greedily maximize marginal coverage reduction
modules.compatibility: call it coverage utility unless a probabilistic observation/update model supports posterior EIG; enforce constraints against all relevant existing/new sites

blocked_transfers: manual Q1 feature weights/6-of-10 threshold without independent calibration
Q2 free period estimates when borehole circumference is known and no distortion model is justified
Bootstrap reversed percentile interval or estimator-switch without likelihood definition
RAF correction coefficients without calibration provenance
using JRCmax=20 as an unexplained cross-stage scale when upstream values reach 60
calling product of heuristic factors calibrated connectivity probability
calling distance coverage posterior uncertainty or its drop expected information gain
checking only new-new spacing if the engineering safety condition applies to existing-new holes
